name: QueryModuleVersion(module, fileVersion[4], productVersion[4]) (DLL version through GetModuleFileNameA and the version.dll imports)
notes: Hooked. 1500 cases with the five imports (GetModuleFileNameA, GetFileVersionInfoSizeA, GetFileVersionInfoA, VerQueryValueA) redirected to logging fakes: every failure step, buffer sizes, random versions; the logged arguments include the zeroed buffer and the initial pointer/length passed to VerQueryValueA. Only al compared (upper eax is leftover). Mutants killed: word order of the file and product versions, handle argument, path size 0x104, size test, initial length (6 of 6).

name: DbgHelpTable::Load (DbgHelp lazy loader; table at 0x10cb000, 0x74 bytes; done flag byte at 0x10caffc)
notes: Hooked (moved here from ExceptionReporter.jsonl). 1501 cases with LoadLibraryA/GetProcAddress/GetCurrentProcess(Id) faked (fake SymInitialize/MiniDumpWriteDump are callable): version 4.x/5.0/5.1/6.x/unknown, ImageHlp fallback, each required symbol missing (aborts, flag unset), optional ones missing, kernel32/tlhelp32 fallback including GetProcAddress(NULL), psapi, SymInitialize failing, garbage in the table beforehand (zeroed), done flag already set. Table bytes, flag, al and the call log compared. Not tested: both DbgHelp.dll and ImageHlp.dll failing (the original calls the null SymInitialize slot and crashes; ORIGINAL-BUG in src). Mutants killed: memset size, required-miss continue, one dropped required symbol, toolhelp fallback, psapi name, NtOpenThread module, done flag, SymInitialize arguments, flag shortcut, version >= 5.1 compare (two variants) (11 of 11).

name: WriteMiniDump(reporter, EXCEPTION_POINTERS*) (thiscall ret 4; reporter->mDumpFile at +0x80)
notes: Hooked (moved here from ExceptionReporter.jsonl). 600 cases with CreateFileA/SetFilePointer/CloseHandle and the DbgHelp table faked: loader failing, no MiniDumpWriteDump, CreateFileA returning null / INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE (ORIGINAL-BUG: carried on) / a handle, preloaded table, long dump file names. Logged: the converted name, all CreateFileA arguments, the exception information struct handed to MiniDumpWriteDump. Mutants killed: OPEN_ALWAYS, FILE_END, client pointers, dump type, CloseHandle dropped, null-only handle test, wrong file name, missing-pointer check (8 of 8).
